$comment: Cloud intel feed for napcat-plugin-qq-guardian. Configured instances may fetch this document, but unpinned data is observation-only. Admission or moderation actions require enforcementMode=enforce and an exact SHA-256 pin for every feed URL. Shape: red_flag_users = network-reported bad-actor QQ IDs, either plain numbers or {id, action: 'reject'|'kick', reason}; risk_keywords = {name, pattern (JS regex), action: mute|kick|notify_admin|log_only}; reject_patterns = JS regexes matched against join-request comments.

risk_keywords.name: fakeOfficial
risk_keywords.pattern: (?:官方|客服|系统)(?:通知|提醒|升级).{0,12}(?:点击|添加|扫码|领取)

risk_keywords.name: freebieScam
risk_keywords.pattern: (?:免费领|扫码领|点击领取).{0,10}(?:皮肤|点券|红包|会员|礼包)

risk_keywords.name: investScam
risk_keywords.pattern: (?:高额回报|稳赚不赔|带你赚钱|内部消息.{0,6}(?:股票|基金|币))

risk_keywords.name: partTimeScam
risk_keywords.pattern: (?:手机兼职|在家赚钱|轻松日入|日入[0-9一二三四五百千]{2,})

risk_keywords.name: accountTrade
risk_keywords.pattern: (?:收|出|买|卖)(?:实名|成品|白号|老号)(?:号|QQ|微信)?
